scope.future_policy: Only clearly fictional successors after the historical cutoff; no predictions of real future officeholders.
scope.claim: Verified starter for each of the seven exact baseline rows. Original-party leadership windows and explicit lifecycle/hand-over gaps, not an exhaustive roster of modern Italy or completed avatar art.
scope.unrepresented_parties: Successor/split organizations and omitted baseline minor parties require distinct reviewed IDs: PPI, CCD, CDU/UDC, PDS/DS/PD, Rifondazione, PdCI, AN/Fiamma Tricolore, FI/PdL/FdI/FLI, Lega, Greens, Radicals, SI/SDI/later PSI, renewed PLI/PSDI/DC and others.

ingestion.runtime_prerequisite: No automatic import. Preserve exact seven party IDs and current person IDs. Party secretary is not automatically President of the Council. Italy requires presidential appointment and confidence of both chambers; executive selection must be separately reviewed. Original party lifecycle transitions and successor IDs need explicit save migration before historical follow-through.
ingestion.people: Compatible Person records. Existing giulio_andreotti and its executive office_links must remain untouched; he is not the DC party secretary in 1990.
ingestion.parties: Compatible Party/Term fields; no fabricated components for individual deputies. Preserve the seven small/large baseline rows separately.
ingestion.intervals: Half-open [from, until). Same-day handovers belong to the incoming holder. Coarse month/year dates express uncertainty, not vacancies; conservative resolution may leave visible gaps.
ingestion.affiliations: Research only office windows, not complete membership. Re-check eligibility and life dates before gameplay promotion.
ingestion.scope_clipping: All seven initial windows start at 1990-01-01 as a scope clip, not original appointment.
ingestion.missing_life_dates: Omitted birth/death bounds are unverified. Missing death does not mean alive.
ingestion.open_terms: Current terms verified only through the research cutoff; the latest dated PRI source is 18 April 2026.

parties.identity_note: Original Christian Democracy baseline. Its 1994 transformation into PPI and the CCD split require distinct successor identities; legal claims to DC continuity remain outside this partial audit.

terms.note: Scope-clipped start; party secretary again from 1989. The 22 February 1990 presidential diary explicitly identifies his party role, distinct from Prime Minister Giulio Andreotti. Successor elected 12 October 1992.

National secretary elected 12 October 1992. January 1994 endpoint is coarse because the municipal biography gives a conflicting PPI date; the original 18 January speech supports the organizational transition, not a resolved legal dissolution date.

gaps.reason: Original baseline party underwent transformation and fragmentation. PPI, CCD, CDU, UDC, later PD participation and multiple modern DC claimants cannot be silently substituted under it_dc. Lifecycle/role-aware migration must precede their leadership import.

parties.identity_note: Original Italian Communist Party, not all later communist or centre-left successor organizations.

terms.note: Scope-clipped start; secretary from 1988. Original PCI voted dissolution on 3 February 1991. PDS and Rifondazione followed separate paths.

gaps.reason: PCI's original organization ended at its final congress. PDS/DS/PD, Rifondazione, PdCI and later parties using the PCI name need separate identities and split/merger history.

parties.identity_note: Original PSI through 1994; later Socialist parties bearing similar names are not automatically the same runtime identity.

terms.note: Scope-clipped start; secretary from 1976. Departure month retained pending exact resignation/effective handover audit; Benvenuto elected 12 February.
Original party assembly recording documents election; by the 25 May interview he had resigned. Exact effective resignation day is not imposed.
Camera commemoration dates election 28 May 1993. June 1994 resignation is recorded; the relationship between his statutory title and subsequent coordination remains unresolved.

gaps.reason: Exact Craxi resignation and effective caretaker interval need original minutes. The month boundary is uncertainty, not a claimed vacancy.
Benvenuto's resignation-to-election transition needs effective dates.

Valdo Spini's coordination and the laburista departure need exact mandates and effective endpoints. His 20 September first-person speech confirms coordination but cannot justify a fabricated continuous general-secretary term.
Original PSI dissolved. Socialisti Italiani, PS, SDI, Nuovo PSI, later PSI and other branches require distinct IDs and separately researched succession.

parties.identity_note: Original MSI-DN baseline. AN emerged at Fiuggi and Rauti's Fiamma Tricolore split requires separate party identity.

terms.note: Scope-clipped start; secretary since December 1987. Fini is the correct 1 January 1990 starter. The congress recording on 14 January contains the election and farewell to incoming secretary Rauti.
Incoming election appears in the 14 January congress recording. July 1991 endpoint is month-level: recording/publication on 9 July does not prove that election occurred on that day.
Foreign Ministry biography distinguishes return as MSI secretary in July 1991 from AN presidency at the January 1995 Fiuggi congress.

gaps.reason: Fiuggi transformation/split requires AN and Fiamma Tricolore identities. Later PdL, FLI and FdI are not a single linear extension of the original MSI row.

parties.identity_note: Continuing PRI. The operational national secretary/coordinator is distinguished from party president, deputy coordinators and parliamentary leaders.

terms.note: Scope-clipped start; elected secretary 12 September 1987. Exact February resignation day requires original minutes.
Acting/regent leadership after La Malfa's withdrawal. Not a separate permanent party presidency; exact handovers remain month-level.
January return is documented by the 21–22 January council, but precise effective day is not imposed. Became party president when Nucara succeeded as secretary on 6 October 2001.

Secretary elected 6 October 2001. Conservative observed-office endpoint: party archive explicitly still calls him secretary for 10 May 2013; half-open scope clip ends the following day, not a claimed resignation. Party president elected 15 March 2014. Exact secretary retirement and intermediate committee mandate need minutes.

Conservative observed-office clip: April 2014 party archive labels Collura national coordinator, and 2015 archive entries retain that role. His successor dates replacement to 2016; exact initial appointment and end day need council minutes.

His December 2016 first-person statement confirms appointment earlier in 2016. Morelli and Piro served on the coordination team; September agenda identifies them as deputies, so they are not fabricated equal secretaries.

Observed-office clip, not asserted accession day: 18 December 2017 party declaration labels him secretary after the December congress. Current office verified by 18 April 2026 National Council resolution; no claim about future real holders.

gaps.reason: End of conservatively verified Nucara secretary coverage. Later presidency and coordinator structure do not establish his resignation day. The 2013-14 committee transition and exact Collura appointment require minutes.
The 2016 coordinator handover is verified only to year precision. This denotes uncertainty overlapping the staged boundary, not a claimed full-year vacancy.
December congress and subsequent council election require precise effective secretary accession; observed declaration is the safe start of the staged secretary window.

parties.identity_note: Original baseline PSDI. Its late-1990s merger, remnant organizations and 2004 revival/modern disputed leadership need separate legal and lifecycle review.

terms.note: Scope-clipped start; foundation biography dates secretary tenure 1988–1992. Do not confuse Senate group leadership or later party presidency with this role.
May council documents incoming secretary. March resignation needs original effective-day confirmation; not extended through successor election.

Contemporary 1 May 1993 newspaper report explicitly describes election at 15:00 the previous day. Late-1994 resignation and caretaker committee need original minutes; do not carry him into January as if no interruption occurred.
29 January congress records acclamation and speech as new secretary. Schietroma's group joined SDI in May 1998; this is not proof every PSDI remnant ceased legal existence.

gaps.reason: Vizzini resignation and interim management need original records.

National caretaker committee preceded the congress. Schietroma chaired coordination, while Carlo Flamment also appears on the regency committee; do not invent a sole permanent secretary or erase the collective body.
Majority joined SDI; remnant, renewed PSDI and contested modern office claims have not been role/lifecycle-audited. No automatic continuity under it_psdi is asserted.

parties.identity_note: Original Liberal Party through dissolution on 6 February 1994, not the later refounded organization or all liberal successors.

terms.note: Scope-clipped start; secretary 1986–1993. Month retained because publication and council recording dates do not by themselves establish exact handover day.

May 1993 interview says elected the previous day while council recording is dated 28 May; keep month-level accession until minutes resolve it. National Archives proceedings date final dissolution vote 6 February 1994.

gaps.reason: Original PLI dissolved. Federation of Liberals, Union of the Centre, later renewed Liberal parties and other branches require their own IDs and researched leadership.

research_issues: DC municipal Martinazzoli biography dates PPI creation differently from the original 18 January 1994 speech; retain a month-level transition and do not invent a legal dissolution.
MSI 14 January 1990 congress recording supports Rauti's election; Fini remains the 1 January starter. July 1991 recording date is not automatically the election date.
PRI SIUSA summary compresses La Malfa's 1987–2001 span and omits Bogi's regency, so original council recordings supply the interruption.

PRI 2016 coordination was a team. Paolo Morelli and Salvatore Piro are described as deputy coordinators in the September agenda, not equal national secretaries. Their roles belong in a later office taxonomy, not fake coalition components.
PSDI SIUSA Assisi organizational page explicitly says its national history was taken from Wikipedia. It was not used as independent primary proof of national legal continuity.
Contemporary l'Unità reports are original event reporting for Ferri's election and the SDI merger. Claims are limited to the actual reported events; copyrighted text is not reproduced.
Exact PSI 1994 coordination and PSDI 1994–95 regency remain gaps. Do not collapse coordinator, deputy, president and secretary into a made-up sole chair.
All terms remain partial until lifecycle migration and presidency/parliamentary-role policy are reviewed; no runtime changes or asset generation belong to this staging task.

portrait_policy.art_scope: Original cartoon likenesses in established game style, interpreted for early 1990s. Preserve actual source dates and avoid claiming later portraits were photographed in 1990.
portrait_policy.licensing: Observed appearance can inform original cartoon design. Reference provenance does not itself grant permission to ship the source photograph. Keep generated-art provenance separate.
